# Salma – Beauty & Lifestyle Content Creator

> Salma is a beauty and lifestyle content creator focused on honest skincare and haircare reviews, cinematic Instagram Reels and daily stories. She is open to brand collaborations.

## Services
- Product Reviews: ingredient breakdowns, multi-day skin and scalp tests, honest verdicts.
- Reels Creation: high-retention cinematic short-form video with aesthetic color grading.
- Daily Story Coverage: unboxings, event previews, day-in-the-life product integrations.
- Brand Collaborations: ambassador programs, co-created masterclasses, campaign launches.

## Niches
Skincare, haircare, beauty lifestyle.
